reference: Toyoshima et al. (2022), Ensemble dynamics and information flow deduction from whole-brain imaging data, PLOS Computational Biology

stimulus_encoding.protocol: 50->25 mM and 25->50 mM alternate every 30 s; even k is down-step, odd k is up-step
stimulus_encoding.observation_scale_note: z-scored ratio columns are multiplied by 0.18 before the DeltaF/F0-calibrated encoder
stimulus_encoding.sign_source: audit of first five recordings, 0-10 s post-step means; operational model input, not a measured activation map

operational_targets.note: NaCl is a sensory perturbation, not a targeted optogenetic input; the target set and ON/OFF signs are explicit modeling assumptions.

benchmark.status: weak; polarity directionally correct, not cross-dataset generalization
